DETAILED ANALYSIS: PERMANENT & OLD WELLBORE AND MILL 13 3/8” CASING Permanent plug and abandon the old 13 3/8 wellbore and mill 13 3/8 casing to below 20 casing shoe for sidetrack to be performed. The old wellbore was plugged and abandoned, and the 13 3/8 casing milled to 1350'MD (

sidetrack was attempted, but the 13 3/8 casing was damaged while milling the 5/8 casing and the well was temporarily abandoned. In November, 1990 after having permanently plugged the old wellbore and milled the 13 3/8 casing, the well was sidetracked below the 20 casing shoe to new bottom hole location. It was then perforated in the Tor and Ekofisk formation
